text:
Lina (marketing): quick async standup — launch checklist run-through. what I did: finalized hero copy and scheduled the benchmark post for 12:30 PT. blockers: analytics event not showing in prod. today: final QA + send to partners. @Jordan can you confirm analytics event status?
Jordan (eng): saw the PR (458) last night and merged to main, but deploy didn’t promote to prod yet. pinging deploy team.
Sam (eng-oncall): noted. Canary is stuck, seeing tokenization errors for long titles. logs show:```Error: Tokenizer length overflow at /app/tokenizer.py:128```
Alex (content): updated headline variants to fit 70 chars, uploaded assets to CDN (path: /cdn/launch-assets/2026-03-17). need alt text approval from Priya.
Priya (design): LGTM on alt text. small nit: image 3 needs different crop for mobile. Alex, can you do 4:3 crop?
Maria (growth): benchmark numbers — last similar launch had 2.1% CTR and 0.8% click-to-trial. target we discussed: 2.5% CTR. I’ll drop the benchmark spreadsheet here: https://redwood.sheets/launch-bench-2026
Lina (marketing): thanks. if the analytics deploy is blocked we should fallback to analytics-v1 for the campaign route to avoid losing events. Jordan, is that a quick toggle?
Jordan (eng): yep, I can flip the routing flag to analytics-v1 for /campaign/* routes. doing it now. :hammer_and_wrench:
DevBot: deploy pipeline triggered -> build #789 -> canary -> run smoke tests. (status: running)
Sam (eng-oncall): adjusted tokenizer thresholds and re-ran canary. smoke tests passed this time. will promote to prod in 5.
Lina (marketing): awesome — planning final push at 12:30 PT. any other blockers?
Alex (content): CR 112 waiting on one review from Maria, I’ll merge after that.
Maria (growth): reviewing CR now, should be done in 10.
Lina (marketing): perfect. if prod changes are live before 12:30 I’ll proceed. shout if anything else pops up — thanks everyone :raised_hands:
